title: Response Object (res)

tableData.title: Common Response Methods
rows: Sends an HTTP response of various types (String, Object, Buffer).
Sends a JSON response (automatically sets Content-Type header).
Sets the HTTP status code (can be chained).
Redirects the client to a different URL.
Sends a static file to the client.

definition: The `res` object represents the HTTP response that an Express app sends when it gets an HTTP request. It is an enhanced version of Node's core `http.ServerResponse` object, providing useful chainable methods like `status()`, `json()`, and `send()`.
